method: 1-5 per axis: originality, footage (x2), interference, convenience, safety, simplicity, tech_risk (5=low risk); physics kills excluded

top4.why: Gravity pays for the flight and the leash pays only the deficit (p99 0.4 N vs kite 12-38 N). Hands-free launch and dock, ~430 px, 52 min.
top4.biggest_risk: thin line behind the skier (hazard to others/snags) and the regulatory class

top4.why: Free viewpoint; landing and waiting in the snow cuts hover to ~10 s per segment, giving 44 min vs 9 min hover-only
top4.biggest_risk: tail-sitter transition in gusts near snow; tipping over above ~6-7 m/s wind

top4.why: Simplest proof of the slope-energy principle; no tether, no motor
top4.biggest_risk: headwind (32 % follow at 5 m/s) and a pick-up at every stop

top4.why: Most surprising: lead-and-snatch with the skier's pole; best used as a mode of I-05/I-01
top4.biggest_risk: pole aim reliability (60-79 % hit) and self-placed-camera scope

killed.I-02: KILLED as a free perch: the skier's wake leaves 4.5-6.3 m/s airspeed at 1-2 m, below stall. The idea survives as I-05's line-guided dock, where the reel supplies the energy and the glider doesn't need to fly the final metre.
killed.I-04: KILLED: L/D about 3 gives gravity-following on only 17 % of skiing time; the speed window is 8.2-13.8 m/s.
killed.I-06: KILLED: 0.2 % L/D gain at 0.4 m, and at knee height it is a strike hazard to other skiers' legs and on moguls.
killed.I-07: KILLED: trip hazard on the piste, uncontrollable over moguls, low occluded view.
killed.I-08: KILLED: mass. A glider could use one (48 g), but it is not worth it over a heated Li-ion cell.
killed.I-09: KILLED: 6-10x the power of a propeller, and on slopes gravity needs no thrust at all.
killed.I-11: KILLED as a mode the product relies on; opportunistic on windward ridges only.
killed.I-13: KILLED as a product (not real appearance footage); possible free bonus clip in any helmet cam.
killed.I-14: KILLED: batteries do not fix the hover-power x KE corner; changing the energy source (gravity) does.

note_for_kite_workstream: I-05 is not a kite: lift balances weight by gliding and the tether carries only drag deficit; the kite agent may reuse the reel/funnel dock and the sled-tow+winch launch.
